coaching.headline: Second loss of the night: seven solo catches, zero wards cleared, two towers to eleven.
coaching.team: Seven solo catches lost this, four of them handing over a major or a tower. First blood at 3.4 was ours and gone by the fight at 4.8: a coin-flip in the river with nothing up, lost 1-4, with no hard crowd control on our side. Greystone caught alone at 10.3 and Scarlett at 17.2 each preceded a Fangtooth by under a minute. Greystone alone again at 28.5 preceded Orb Prime and two inhibitors. Eden caught three of us alone and finished with 44,965 damage to heroes while two of five bought armor. We won five fights and cashed two, the fight at 23.1 and the pick at 29.4. Zero wards destroyed to their six and both seedlings theirs. Next game: nobody walks alone in the minute before a Fangtooth, and the river gets dewarded before we cross it.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The solo catches decided it. Greystone alone at 10.3 preceded the first Fangtooth, Scarlett alone at 17.2 the second. Then Legion and Scarlett died 0-2 at Orb Prime at 27.7, Greystone was caught alone at 28.5, and Orb Prime plus two inhibitors fell with three of us dead.
coaching.whatWorked: The pick at 29.4: Renna and Greystone caught Dekker, Khaimera and Eden at our inhibitor, won it 3-0, and Primal Fangtooth followed. Win at home, then walk to the prize.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco was in the fights and behind on vision. Fifty-four percent participation, 17,172 healing, the most on our side, the full field core built, never first to die. Two deaths before minute 10, one alone to Eden at 7.8, and nine wards to Dekker's 12 with none of theirs cleared. A solo catch in three of his last four films.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: The carry lane was lost and the carry never hit a structure. Legion finished 6 kills, 7 deaths and zero damage to objectives on 12,851 gold; Eden finished 10 kills, 44,965 damage to heroes and 20,642 gold. The duo went down four times to their two before minute 10. Legion died first at Orb Prime and in the last fight.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett won the duels and lost the walks. Four kills: the double on Dekker and Eden at 14.1, and Eden again in the fight at 23.1. Then caught alone by Eden at 17.2, and Fangtooth fell at 18. Caught alone again by Crunch at 21.3. Most gold on our side at 16,024, zero damage to objectives.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Greystone's two solo deaths each cost a major. Caught alone by Dekker at 10.3, and Fangtooth fell at 11.1. Caught alone by Morigesh at 28.5, and Orb Prime plus two inhibitors fell with him dead. In between, the most objective damage on our side, 23,868, on three items, no armor. Multiple solo catches in two of his last three films.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna carried the damage and paid alone once. Eight kills led the team, from first blood on Khaimera at 3.4 to the fight at 29.4, won 3-0, that brought Primal Fangtooth. Seven deaths, one alone to Dekker at 20.7 with an outer tower falling at 21.2. A solo catch in each of his last three films; three wards all game.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Maco hit 54% participation and 17,172 healing on the full core, but placed nine wards to Dekker's 12 and cleared none.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Legion put zero damage on objectives and 12,851 gold against Eden's 20,642, and died first at Orb Prime and in the last fight.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: Scarlett killed Eden twice and was caught alone twice, by Eden at 17.2 before Fangtooth fell and by Crunch at 21.3.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Greystone's solo deaths at 10.3 and 28.5 each preceded a lost major, Fangtooth then Orb Prime, with no armor bought.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Renna led with eight kills and first blood, then handed Dekker a solo catch at 20.7 with the outer tower falling after.

23.1.call: This is the method. Scarlett, Maco, Legion and Renna won it 3-2 at their outer tower, the tower fell, and Fangtooth followed. Three won fights before it, at 3.4 and 14.1 among them, were walked away from with nothing.

29.4.call: The right fight: Renna and Greystone caught Dekker, Khaimera and Eden at our inhibitor, won it 3-0, and Primal Fangtooth followed. A pick at home, then the prize: the method three earlier wins skipped.

30.9.call: Primal Fangtooth was ours: four of us died taking it, three to Eden, and the last inhibitor and core fell at 32 with four of five dead. At two towers to eleven, that is the wrong trade.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Maco on the full field core, Crescelia, Enra's Blessing and Windcaller, with Vanguardian fourth; on core, nothing to teach here.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Vanquisher, Tainted Rounds, Nuclear Rounds and Terminus swaps the core's Malady and Deathstalker, both armor shred and penetration, for critical chance and anti-heal; no fight here isolates that swap, so nothing to teach beyond zero armor against Eden's 44,965 damage to heroes.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis fits a rifle carry who empties a magazine into one target: every third consecutive hit on the same hero deals a share of their max health, and Melting Point adds damage against heavy armor.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: No field core exists for Scarlett offlane; five items on the most gold on our side, 16,024, with 36,382 damage mitigated, so the build did its job and nothing to teach here.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Thraex suits the Crunch matchup because Scarlett wins it by staying on one target through a long trade: the mark raises her damage to the last hero hit and cuts theirs to her, and Ferocity stacks attack speed the longer the duel runs.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Sky Splitter, Lightning Hawk and Tainted Bastion is attack speed and critical chance with magic resist as the only defense; the core of Overlord, Augmentation and Basilisk is health plus armor shred. Greystone took 55,176 damage, the most on our side; four of six deaths were to Khaimera and Eden.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Thraex fits a frontline bruiser who leaps in and stays: the mark on the last hero Greystone hits lowers their damage to him while raising his, and Savage Strikes adds on-hit damage to every empowered Sacred Oath basic.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Two of three core items, Entropy and Overseer, with Tainted Scepter's anti-heal against Dekker's healing and Khaimera's regen in place of Wraith Leggings; eight kills say it worked, nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh fits Renna because Soulfire, Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift all land ability hits that Vesh turns into a damage-over-time, and Mind Rot adds current-health damage against a Khaimera who sits in the zone to regenerate.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.3s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Dekker. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

eden.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Focal Lens, crest Pacifier
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,405 hero damage a minute, more than 87% of Eden carry players this patch (33% of the team's). The damage came from Imperator, Tainted Rounds, Scattershot.
Eden dealt 44,965 hero damage, 33% of their team's, with +317 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Maco (level 17 estimated: about 140 physical armor, 93 after penetration) and Renna (level 17 estimated: about 100 physical armor, 63 after penetration) that is about 24% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 2,785 healing recorded.

Lesson: Eden's penetration cut through: Maco took about 24% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 140, about 93 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Scattershot, Demolisher, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Tainted Rounds, Pacifier, Savage Strikes.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Eden killed built physical armor (Maco, Scarlett). Anti-heal on Legion, Scarlett, Greystone, Renna. We killed Eden 4 times.

Copy it? Thraex: 52.5% in 101 Eden carry games, above the hero's 50.3%; this 3-item core: 53.5% in 129 games, below the 56.4% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

khaimera.loadout: Demiurge (Bio-Mechanical Fusion + Bloatware), augment Jungle Invasion, crest Winter's Fury
fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,260 hero damage a minute, more than 94% of Khaimera jungle players this patch (30% of the team's). The damage came from Prophecy, Orion, Oathkeeper.
Cull at top rank: 60s base, about 36.8s by the end (39% shorter) from 63 ability haste: Prophecy 15, Orion 15, Oathkeeper 15, Tainted Scepter 10, Winter's Fury 8.
19 takedowns (10 kills, 9 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Khaimera dealt 40,309 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +0 physical power from items.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Oathkeeper (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 65 (+35%) Damage On-Hit.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Winter's Fury (crest): Release a sphere of icey energy that expands over 3s. Deals 100 (+20%) Damage to Enemies inside the zone. Applies a 50% Decaying Slow over 2.5s.
Demiurge (Eternal): Increase stats gained from Items (excluding passives) by 10%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.
Bloatware (Eternal minor): Gain 0.5% increased Damage and 0.75% Damage Reduction per Item.
Sustain: Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; 14,573 healing recorded.
Toughness: +475 health; took 67,854 damage, mitigated 34,223, died 10 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Orion, Oathkeeper.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Khaimera killed built physical armor (Maco, Scarlett). We killed Khaimera 10 times.
Copy it? Demiurge: 48.4% in 155 Khaimera jungle games, below the hero's 51.7%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Cull came back about every 37s instead of 60s by the end (39% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
